article.story: LAS VEGAS -- — Tounde Yessoufou scored 18 of his 23 points in the second half, helping No. 13 St. John's shake off a quick turnaround after playing the previous night to defeat Iowa State 80-75 on Friday in the Players Era 16. Ian Jackson added 17 points, Keyshawn Hall had 16 and Lefteris Liotopoulos scored 10 for the Red Storm (7-1), who went 2-1 in the tournament, finishing in third place in the Michelob Ultra Arena bracket. Tre Singleton had 26 points for the Cyclones (4-3), who lost two of three in Las Vegas. Dominykas Pleta added 15. St. John's had the challenge of returning to the court on a quick turnaround. The Red Storm rallied from 24 down in the second half Thursday night before losing at the buzzer to No. 25 Louisville, leaving the floor about 8:30 p.m. PST. Their game against Iowa State tipped off at 10 a.m. the following morning. Both teams shot at a high rate, with St. John's making half of its shots and Iowa State hitting 52.8% from the floor. But both teams also were sloppy, combining to commit 44 turnovers. The Red Storm found a way to win despite scoring way below their 92.9-point average. Iowa State entered as the nation's fifth-best team in adjusted defensive efficiency, according to Kenpom, and it held the Red Storm well below its 92.9-point average. The Red Storm put together a 13-point second-half run to take a 52-44 lead. Iowa State got as close as three on three occasions over the final three minutes, but St. John's never lost the lead. Up next Iowa State: Hosts Alcorn State on Tuesday night. St. John's: Hosts Columbia (Calif.) on Tuesday night. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
